summary: Added a local-first Resident Conversations workspace to the Office of the Steward command center. The workspace surfaces resident selection, role and mailbox summaries, recent institutional messages, linked source artifacts, and transcript/audit placeholders while preserving messages, work packages, artifacts, and audit records as institutional sources of truth.
known_limitations: Conversation entry is a placeholder surface only; this package intentionally does not store chat transcripts or implement autonomous agents.
Recent messages are derived from local Collaboration Bus message artifacts and simple resident/mailbox matching, not from a remote or live chat service.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
